steps.text: 8:27 A.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Training Grounds

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: You ready? Here I go!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Nice try, mate!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who says good morning before they knock ya sideways? You're being daft!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Why don't you try me!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Your fist's hard as pillows, all floppy. I could bludgeon better with brown bread gone two days in the freezer.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Huff... you're clearly not as fast as me!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: ...Why can't I hit you?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Keep trying! No use, mate!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who taught you how to fight like this?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: My dad taught me... wrestling techniques... my dad's a really amazing policeman!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Eh? Dad this and dad that? Ya still a little kid then?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Okay, eyes on the prize! I'll find an opening!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: 'Ey, that one was gettin' somewhere!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Keep goin'! C'mon, let's go again!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (I can't—I can't get away...)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: You attack with... such a crazy angle! What kind of style is that?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Eh? Style? I don't think about any style when I fight, mate!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: If you can harp on about your fighting, show some skill instead, why don't you! I wanna work up a sweat here, come on!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Getting faster—

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Too slow! Pick it up!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Heyah!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (Ack, my eyes! That was an inch away! Too close!)

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Huff... huff... hah...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: (I don't even have the chance to hit back... and I took one right in the stomach...)

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Weak! Flip me, this is weak!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey. Oi, time out, you. You lookin' down on me or somethin'?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I'm hittin' you serious here. Come on, my eye tells me you've got skills, but everything you do comes out all dawdlin'.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Listen, alright, you little tyke? Get your fist, from just now, and smash my nose in, alright? My nose, right here! See it? Just bump it, 'n rose-red'll come flyin' out!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I... ahhah...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: My dad said... my fist should only make enemies bleed...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Aaaauugh, you do my head in! Mate, that is ALL pointless right now!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: It could be so bleedin' simple! A fight's just a fight! Why've ya gotta think so much?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: ...Hah!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Well, alright. You stand up pretty good to a thumpin'.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You know if I smacked any normal tosser around a couple times, they'd have been cryin', beggin' me to forgive 'em by now?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I... I'm not gonna beg.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: You're insanely strong, but you can't... underestimate me.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Ey-hey, I like that. Gettin' interesting again.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Seein' as you ain't run, I'm gonna hurry up and let you—

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...block my fist?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What's this? Whip? Hey, not bad, you.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Jackie, head down. Get Lancet-2 to dress your wounds as a holdover, and then report to Medical.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: But training's still...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The morning training course will permit your absence. Extenuating circumstances. Don't expect this again.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Furthermore, remember this. Rhodes Island or no, training grounds are a battlefield, and you only face opponents, not friends. In front of the enemy, your lenience will be a weakness.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Next time you're beaten like this, I'll have to consider giving you supplementary courses.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Got it, Instructor!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Uh... Operator Indra, thank you for training with me today! Next time I'll put on a even better show!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Tch. Flippin' weak.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hold it there.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oi, you wanna go too? You look bang-up, I'd reckon.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I'm not going to play about with you.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Play? You sayin' fightin's play? Oi, can I check a sec, yeah? Do you know how I got here?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Operator Indra, your current conduct is very juvenile, in my opinion.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You're no longer a student. You don't need me setting courses for you. But I'd still like to give you some suggestions.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Then first off—before you're properly prepared, you are not to step one foot on the training grounds again.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Huh? Why? That little rabbit told me if I wanted a fight, I could come here and all.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I am not going to waste time pointing out how many incorrect assumptions you've made in that one sentence.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Briefly, the training grounds are not a place to vent your private moods. Operators do not learn from one another with the goal of causing permanent harm to the other party.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Once you've gotten things straight, you can come back again. The new recruits very much need the genuine combat guidance your experience provides.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: But for now, I would like you to leave.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hmph. The whole lot here's just people who go on and on. Each one's more boring than the last.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Stuck in here every day without a fight's seriously killing me.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: What's the point of the food here? Meat 'n' potatoes are enough. Why d'you need all this variety? What's all the seasoning about? Gettin' sick of chewin' it, it's making my mouth go rotten!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And this room! Metal plates cold as a fridge, and you've gotta squash to get in! Is this somewhere people should stay? It's like jail!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Aarrrrgh!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: (Thump—)
Haha.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who is it?
Carry on. Bit more force, and you'll give this wall a new cubby-hole.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: God, I couldn't have asked for anyone more dull to show up. Morgan, stop standin' out there if you can help it. Come in here and give us a scrap. Lemme get some relief.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't feel like it. Couldn't hit me if you wanted, but who knows how long it'd be before you're too worked up not to punch a wall again.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: And anyway, I'm not like you. Got plenty to do.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Tch. You and your sodding business. You couldn't pay me to figure it out. I know you just run around completely out of sight, anyway, exactly like you used to.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Ay-yi-yi. I'm not gonna forget about you no matter how busy I am, Hannah, love~

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Heard you made a huge fuss at the training grounds. Got shooed out right after?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...You just came here to laugh at me, didn't ya?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Tsk, tsk. You'll hurt me, talking like that.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You'd never believe if I was worried for you, so just treat it as me here on Vina's behalf, checking if you haven't made a right mess for her.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Her Majesty knows?!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't work yourself up. I didn't tell on you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: But. We're aboard someone else's ship right now. Could you imagine whatever you do not reaching her ears somehow? Who do you think she is?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Tch, is it not enough to admit it's my fault this time?! I'll go find our Majesty myself.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Good, no rush. Been here a while now, anyway, so we know just how the people are at Rhodes, right? Vina's in an alright spot. None of us need to lose much sleep at night.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...Yeah, you're right, I get it.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: People here are fine, even. Not like the lot we used to see... too rotten, or too bloody weak.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But that doesn't mean I've gotta like living like this. Hmph.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You say you don't like it. Still not used to it yet, are you?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I... tch. How'm I gonna get used to this?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Just, all of a sudden, don't need to play hide and seek every day. Won't be out of a place to sleep for nights on end. Don't need to worry when I sleep if anyone'll come to do us in.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Do miss those days a little. Even if you were dead asleep, eyes'd snap open the moment you heard something. Even throw a couple fists at the air.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...And who's the bastard who kept sneaking up? You see how generous I was, not giving you a black eye. Pulled my punches.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha, hahaha.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I mean, it's not just a good night's rest. You can always get something warm to eat here, and you don't need to worry if the bastard across you's gonna pull somethin' out an' mug you while you're chewing.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We left Londinium ages ago. When've we ever had it like this?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: One, two, three... I haven't seen any blood for a whole fortnight. Tell me somethin', Morgan, show me the light. How'm I gonna get used to this?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Listen to what comes out of your mouth. It's all proof Vina was right to bring us to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Rhodes Island can give us everything we need. And I don't just mean a bed and some food. And you've never had an interest in me talking about it, but you know it yourself, don't you?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Yeah. Don't need to know who my enemy is, just gotta know they're the enemy. I can tell who my real friends are, and who can be of use to Vina.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And I still haven't forgotten what I came here with her for. I wanna see her draw her sword. For that day, I, Indra, will do whatever it takes.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But... Morgan, in my dreams recently, I've been seeing all those kiddies we left behind.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: I get it. You're actually worried about those bunch, aren't you?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Who'd worry for 'em?! You think I'm the bleedin' heart sort?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Honest?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I dunno...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's the thing! I don't know anything!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I don't know how they're doing, if they got hurt, if they got sick, if... someone else's givin' 'em trouble. Especially all that lot.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I lie on this comfy, clean mattress, and I can't help but think, what about them? How are they doing, right now?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You understand those girls better than anyone. All these years we've gotten to know each other, like the backs of our own hands.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Like you could forget. We know better than anyone, living in Londinium since we were kids, how to make it out of each fight alive, don't we?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I believe in 'em.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: —Just like they always believed in me. Morgan, you remember too, right? Each one of them kept up with us, right behind our arses while they were still little.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Ha, of course I remember. Right, and you kept behind my arse.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, no interruptions, yeah? Me behind you was 'cause you ran too fast. I was lookin' to kick you up there with the right opportunity.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Either way, back then... we swore an oath. Never mind if our days would ever be sunny—at the very least, no matter what, each person would have a share.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And now... now... *sigh*.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Don't go sighing. We've followed Vina so far. Do you really regret it now?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Indra.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you understand the battle plans I just laid out?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: First half I'm clear as day, but the last bit... Vina, you didn't say where I head to after I'm done.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: For that part, I want you to choose for yourself.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You can come to this position, and meet up with me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You can also head for that position. They'll be waiting for you there around then.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And then you need to get moving with them quickly. Do whatever you need to after that. Don't come back here, and don't find me again.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina... do you...?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yeah, I need to leave now.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Is it the bunch from outside?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The dark clouds are getting closer. Surely you've sensed it too.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Tch. That bunch of bastards are sticky as the snot in my nose! I'll send 'em packing whether they're one or the lot.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This isn't as simple as brawling for territory anymore. More and more are getting wounded. It won't be long before the situation's beyond what we can handle with our current strength.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We can't sit and wait to get killed. Before that... I need to seize the initiative.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Fine. Morgan said as much anyway.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But—I'm not like her. I don't think about all that much rubbish. I just need you to tell me. Has this day come?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yeah. This day has come.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're all in danger if I stay here. None of you would want to be cowards, and neither would I. But needless sacrifices disgust me more than that.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And besides, the struggle's never going to end, whether in Londinium or beyond. We'll always have things to do.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Then I'll follow you! Wherever you are, I'll be. Long as there's a day you need my fist, I'll be with you!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Indra, you're my most trusted friend. I enjoy every battle we have side by side. But today, I want you to understand I'm not ordering you to go with me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Because I'm not certain myself when I'll be able to return here. If you decide to come with me, you won't be either. From here on, we'll be wandering somewhere different than before every day.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You can imagine all we'll face in future. You don't need me saying it.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And besides... you're the first person I'd ask. After all, before I joined Glasgow, you were the head. I was thinking, maybe you'd be more willing to stay here for them.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I told you, this isn't anything I even need to think about.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: The moment I recognized you as my Master, my Majesty, I decided every day of mine right there.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Where you need to go, that's where I need to go. For you, my two hands will deal with your enemies, and hug your friends.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Today, if you want me to stay behind, I won't say a single word back. I'll stay behind for you.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But if you're asking me—then you don't need to ask more than once.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I've only got one answer.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I believe in you, Vina, you're my liege!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Regrets... never. Not for all eternity.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Following Her Majesty's the most correct decision I've ever made in my life!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Ay-yi-yi, you're gonna wake Vina up from the other end of the corridor, raising your voice that high.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey, don't give me lip. Yesterday night she was thinking things over so late, she must be sleeping like a baby right now.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Alright, alright, you're alive enough that I don't need to keep chatting with you now.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Keep punching a hole in that wall. Make your way through, you can escape whenever you want, nah?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I bloody well... I...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You bastard, Morgan. They didn't write the word 'escape' in my dictionary!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Forget it. Tch.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Rhodes Island. My liege chose Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Then so do I.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...Doesn't change how crap of an eyesore being stuck in this room is!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Does my head in! Does my flippin' head in!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Oi, who is it? You're not Morgan. Idiot would never learn how to knock.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: It's—it's me, Operator Indra.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Pounded up like that and you can still stand straight? You're pretty good, tyke.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Oh, you mean these wounds? Haha, I'm alright. The misses at Medical all helped treat them for me. When my dad used to take me training, sometimes I'd mess myself up just as bad too.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: So you're not here to get one over?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Uh, revenge? No, it's okay, these injuries you left were all from helping me train, right?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You little tyke. I think I might like you.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Heheh, is that a compliment, Operator Indra? Then can I ask you to train with me next time too?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You still wanna get whupped?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Just now in the medbay, I was thinking, your style—uh, not style, your fighting! Yeah, your fighting! Your fighting's really awesome, Operator Indra!

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: I could tell there was so much I'd never learned before, and I wanna learn it properly from you! Pleaaase!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: ...You wanna learn from me?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hey. You sure? I just beat you black and blue and you've still got the guts to hang around me?

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Part of why I got beat's because I wasn't strong enough. That's not your fault.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hah. People here really are nothin' like the ones outside.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That Perro with the whip...

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Mm-hm, that's Miss Dobermann! She's our Instructor.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Don't matter what she's called! ...Tch, what's that look on your face for? Fine, I get it, Dobermann, okay.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That Dobermann? She said if I was prepared properly, I could go back.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: So let's give it a whirl and see.

steps.name: Jackie
steps.text: Woah! You're really gonna do it? This rules!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hah, too early to get happy. I don't do manners with my fists up.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: But... heh, learnin' from one another, eh. Just puttin' on some restraint, ain't it? Nothin' hard about that.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Givin' a rascal like you some pointers, that's all. Never been a problem for me!
